verdicts.reason: The two are almost identical and share the same failures. The image is left as a thin banner strip floating in the upper middle, the headline wraps to leave an orphaned "us.", and the bottom ~40% of the canvas is dead white space, so the layout doesn't use the taller format. A gets the nod only because its headline keeps a slightly roomier right margin; B's "for" and "us." sit closer to the canvas edge.
